49: 	| { type: "connected"; user?: { id: string; name: string } }
50: 	| { type: "streak"; user?: { id: string; name: string }; data: StreakData }

52: 	| { type: "session:update"; user?: { id: string; name: string }; data: SessionData }
53: 	| { type: "session:end"; user?: { id: string; name: string }; data: SessionData }
54: 	| { type: "match:insert"; user?: { id: string; name: string }; data?: MatchData }
55: 	| { type: "match:delete"; user?: { id: string; name: string }; data?: MatchData }
56: 	| { type: "standings:update"; user?: { id: string; name: string }; data?: MatchData };
57: 
58: interface UseSeasonSSEOptions {
59: 	leagueSlug: string;
60: 	seasonSlug: string;
61: 	seasonId: string;
62: 	currentUserId?: string;
63: 	enabled?: boolean;
64: }
65: 
66: export function useSeasonSSE({
67: 	leagueSlug,
68: 	seasonSlug,
69: 	seasonId,
70: 	currentUserId,
71: 	enabled = true,
72: }: UseSeasonSSEOptions) {
73: 	const trpc = useTRPC();
74: 	const queryClient = useQueryClient();
75: 	const wsRef = useRef<WebSocket | null>(null);
76: 	const reconnectTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
77: 	const reconnectAttemptsRef = useRef(0);
78: 	const enabledRef = useRef(enabled);
79: 	const paramsRef = useRef({ leagueSlug, seasonSlug, seasonId, currentUserId });
80: 	const [connectionStatus, setConnectionStatus] = useState<
81: 		"connecting" | "connected" | "disconnected"
82: 	>("connecting");
83: 
84: 	const trpcRef = useRef(trpc);
85: 	const queryClientRef = useRef(queryClient);
86: 	trpcRef.current = trpc;
87: 	queryClientRef.current = queryClient;
88: 
89: 	enabledRef.current = enabled;
90: 	paramsRef.current = { leagueSlug, seasonSlug, seasonId, currentUserId };
91: 
92: 	useEffect(() => {
93: 		let isMounted = true;
94: 
95: 		const connect = () => {
96: 			if (!enabledRef.current || !isMounted) return;
97: 
98: 			setConnectionStatus("connecting");
99: 			const { leagueSlug, seasonSlug, seasonId, currentUserId } = paramsRef.current;
100: 			const protocol = window.location.protocol === "https:" ? "wss:" : "ws:";
101: 			const wsUrl = `${protocol}//${window.location.host}/api/sse/${leagueSlug}/${seasonSlug}`;
102: 			const ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl);
103: 			wsRef.current = ws;
104: 
105: 			ws.onopen = () => {
106: 				reconnectAttemptsRef.current = 0;
107: 				if (isMounted) {
108: 					setConnectionStatus("connected");
109: 				}
110: 			};
111: 
112: 			ws.onmessage = (event) => {
113: 				try {
114: 					const parsed: SeasonSSEEvent = JSON.parse(event.data);
115: 
116: 					if (parsed.type === "connected") {
117: 						return;
118: 					}
119: 
120: 					const t = trpcRef.current;
121: 					const qc = queryClientRef.current;
122: 					const isOwnEvent = parsed.user?.id === currentUserId;
123: 
124: 					if (parsed.type === "streak" && parsed.data) {
125: 						window.dispatchEvent(
126: 							new CustomEvent("streak-event", {
127: 								detail: {
128: 									playerId: parsed.data.playerId,
129: 									playerName: parsed.data.playerName,
130: 									playerImage: parsed.data.playerImage,
131: 									streak: parsed.data.streak,
132: 									timestamp: parsed.data.timestamp,
133: 									isTeam: parsed.data.isTeam,
134: 								},
135: 							})
136: 						);
137: 						return;
138: 					}
139: 
140: 					if (
141: 						parsed.type === "session:start" ||
142: 						parsed.type === "session:update" ||
143: 						parsed.type === "session:end"
144: 					) {
145: 						const sessionId = parsed.data?.sessionId ?? parsed.data?.session?.id;
146: 						window.dispatchEvent(
147: 							new CustomEvent("session-event", {
148: 								detail: { type: parsed.type, sessionId, userName: parsed.user?.name },
149: 							})
150: 						);
151: 
152: 						if (sessionId) {
153: 							qc.invalidateQueries({
154: 								queryKey: t.session.getById.queryKey({ sessionId }),
155: 							});
156: 						}
157: 						qc.invalidateQueries({
158: 							queryKey: t.session.getActive.queryKey({ seasonSlug }),
159: 						});
160: 
161: 						if (parsed.type === "session:update" || parsed.type === "session:end") {
162: 							qc.invalidateQueries({
163: 								queryKey: t.seasonPlayer.getStanding.queryKey({ seasonSlug }),
164: 							});
165: 							qc.invalidateQueries({
166: 								queryKey: t.seasonTeam.getStanding.queryKey({ seasonSlug }),
167: 							});
168: 							qc.invalidateQueries({
169: 								queryKey: t.match.getLatest.queryKey({ seasonSlug }),
170: 							});
171: 						}
172: 						return;
173: 					}
174: 
175: 					if (!isOwnEvent) {
176: 						if (parsed.type === "match:insert" || parsed.type === "match:delete") {
177: 							qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["infinite-matches", seasonId] });
178: 							qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["matches", seasonId] });
179: 						}
180: 
181: 						if (
182: 							(parsed.type === "standings:update" && parsed.data?.standings) ||
183: 							parsed.type === "match:insert" ||
184: 							parsed.type === "match:delete"
185: 						) {
186: 							qc.invalidateQueries({
187: 								queryKey: t.seasonPlayer.getStanding.queryKey({ seasonSlug }),
188: 							});
189: 							qc.invalidateQueries({
190: 								queryKey: t.seasonTeam.getStanding.queryKey({ seasonSlug }),
191: 							});
192: 							qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: t.seasonPlayer.getTop.queryKey({ seasonSlug }) });
193: 							qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: t.seasonPlayer.getAll.queryKey({ seasonSlug }) });
194: 							qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: t.season.getCountInfo.queryKey({ seasonSlug }) });
195: 							qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: t.match.getLatest.queryKey({ seasonSlug }) });
196: 							qc.invalidateQueries({
197: 								queryKey: t.season.getFixtures.queryKey({ seasonSlug }),
198: 							});
199: 						}
200: 					}
201: 
202: 					if (parsed.user && parsed.user.id !== currentUserId) {
203: 						if (parsed.type === "match:insert") {
204: 							toast.info(`${parsed.user.name} registered a match`);
205: 						} else if (parsed.type === "match:delete") {
206: 							toast.info(`${parsed.user.name} deleted a match`);
207: 						}
208: 					}
209: 				} catch {
210: 					// ignore malformed events
211: 				}
212: 			};
213: 
214: 			ws.onclose = () => {
215: 				wsRef.current = null;
216: 				if (isMounted) {
217: 					setConnectionStatus("disconnected");
218: 					const delay = Math.min(1000 * 2 ** reconnectAttemptsRef.current, 30000);
219: 					reconnectAttemptsRef.current++;
220: 					reconnectTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(connect, delay);
221: 				}
222: 			};
223: 		};
224: 
225: 		connect();
226: 
227: 		return () => {
228: 			isMounted = false;
229: 			reconnectAttemptsRef.current = 0;
230: 			if (reconnectTimeoutRef.current) {
231: 				clearTimeout(reconnectTimeoutRef.current);
232: 			}
233: 			if (wsRef.current) {
234: 				wsRef.current.close();
235: 			}
236: 		};
237: 	}, [leagueSlug, seasonSlug, seasonId, enabled]);
238: 
239: 	return {
240: 		connectionStatus,
241: 		disconnect: () => {
242: 			if (wsRef.current) {
243: 				wsRef.current.close();
244: 				wsRef.current = null;
245: 			}
246: 		},
247: 	};
248: }
